name: ESC Pause Menu
author: Matias
description: Pressing ESC during a session opens a pause menu instead of leaving straight away. Race: Continue, Retire to pits or Exit race (with confirmation). Practice, qualifying, warm-up and test day: Continue or Return to pits. In multiplayer and CO-OP the menu opens without pausing (needs Lightloader with the 2026-10-10 broker; older ones keep vanilla ESC online).
